pit_fundamental_funnel.layer_1_quality: 5Y Avg ROCE/ROE > 15.0%, 3Y/5Y Sales & Profit CAGR > 10.0%, 5Y CFO/PAT > 0.80, D/E < 0.50, Market Cap > 1,000 Cr
pit_fundamental_funnel.layer_2_accounting: Reject if OCF negative with positive Net Profit for 2 consecutive years or Other Income > 25% PAT
pit_fundamental_funnel.layer_3_valuation: PE or PB <= 0.75 x 5-Year Rolling Median PE/PB
pit_fundamental_funnel.layer_4_cheapness_attribution: 52W Price DD >= 25.0% AND TTM OPM/ROCE drop <= 15.0% from 3Y average

three_stage_exit_model.stage_1_accumulation: Thesis break (Profit/ROCE drop > 20%), Max Loss Stop (-25%), Time Stop (18 months / 450 sessions)
three_stage_exit_model.stage_2_trend_reclaim: Weekly close above 200-DMA. Trail 200-DMA (weekly close below by > 5% or 2 consecutive weekly closes below)
three_stage_exit_model.stage_3_profit_taking: At +50% gain, sell 50% shares. Trail remaining 50% shares using 50-DMA (weekly close below 50-DMA by > 3%)
